properties.areaDesc: Greene, IN; Knox, IN; Sullivan, IN
properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 15 at 7:56PM EDT until October 15 at 11:00PM EDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southwestern Greene County in southwestern Indiana...
North Central Knox County in southwestern Indiana...
Southeastern Sullivan County in southwestern Indiana...

* WHEN...Until 1100 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Overflowing poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 754 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2.5 inches of rain
have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1.5 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Linton, Carlisle, Oaktown and Pleasantville.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 11 PM EDT THIS EVENING

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 15 at 6:53PM CDT until October 15 at 10:00PM CDT by NWS San Angelo TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northwestern Kimble County in west central Texas...
Southwestern Menard County in west central Texas...
Southeastern Schleicher County in west central Texas...
Northeastern Sutton County in west central Texas...

* WHEN...Until 1000 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 653 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 0.75 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.25 to 1 inch are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Eldorado, Menard, Fort Mckavett, The Intersection Of Us-190 And
Ranch Road 2084, Camp Sol Mayer, The Intersection Of Ranch Road
2596 And Ranch Road 864, Us-277 Near The Sutton- Schleicher
County Line and The Intersection Of Us-83 And Highway 29.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

In hilly terrain there are hundreds of low water crossings which are
potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded
roads. Find an alternate route.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 10 PM CDT THIS EVENING

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 15 at 6:46PM CDT until October 15 at 7:30PM CDT by NWS Fort Worth TX
properties.description:
At 646 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from Lake Weatherford to near Cresson, moving east at 20
mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Fort Worth, Burleson, Cleburne, Weatherford, Benbrook, Saginaw, White
Settlement, Crowley, Azle, River Oaks, Everman, Keene, Joshua, Sansom
Park, Lake Worth, Eagle Mountain, Willow Park, Edgecliff Village,
Aledo, and Westworth Village.
properties.instruction:
For your protection stay inside a sturdy structure and keep away from
windows.

properties.areaDesc: Daviess, IN; Knox, IN
properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued October 15 at 7:41PM EDT until October 15 at 8:15PM EDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
TORIND

The National Weather Service in Indianapolis has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
East central Knox County in southwestern Indiana...
Central Daviess County in southwestern Indiana...

* Until 815 PM EDT.

* At 740 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 8 miles west of Washington, or 9 miles north of
Petersburg, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Washington, Monroe City, Wheatland, and Montgomery.
properties.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

CMAMtext: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 8:15 PM EDT. Take shelter now. Check media.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 8:15 PM EDT. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.
